conventions.evidence: 'test' = asserted by an upstream test; 'code' = read directly off upstream code (no test asserts that exact value).
conventions.layer: which upstream function/component the vector exercises

outcome_values.error_event: HTTP 200 chunked stream carrying exactly one ERROR watch event, then the stream closes (cacher newErrWatcher)
outcome_values.direct_error: Watch() returns an error before a stream exists; surfaces as a non-200 HTTP status
outcome_values.established: stream stays open and delivers the listed events
outcome_values.immediate_close: stream opens and closes with zero events (cacher newImmediateCloseWatcher)
outcome_values.clean_eof: stream ends with no ERROR event
